svg.title: Weekly commits to each protocol: official and third-party repositories
svg.desc: Small multiples, one panel per protocol, shared scale, official and third-party lines. MCP 4327 official and 3471 third-party commits; A2A 2622 official and 155 third-party commits; x402 1260 official and 935 third-party commits; AGNTCY 2159 official commits; MPP 1304 official and 387 third-party commits; Web Bot Auth 126 official and 1054 third-party commits; UCP 798 official and 312 third-party commits; KYA-OS 651 official commits; L402 306 official and 233 third-party commits; PAP 159 official and 348 third-party commits; ERC-8004 81 official and 237 third-party commits; ACP 100 official and 148 third-party commits; AP2 11 official and 138 third-party commits; KYAPay 72 official and 77 third-party commits; ANS 125 official and 14 third-party commits; TAP 0 official and 130 third-party commits; x401 57 official and 4 third-party commits; Verifiable Intent 4 official and 15 third-party commits; no data for Baselayer KYA, Stripe SPT, Amex Intent Intelligence
svg.text: Weekly commits to each protocol: official and third-party repositories
Last 52 weeks to 19 Nov 2026. Same scale in every panel (0 to 360), sorted by total commits.
Each line adds commits across its repositories, which are listed below. Dashed shading means no repository existed yet.

svg.text: Baselayer KYA: closed commercial product: no public repository or package.
Stripe SPT: proprietary API: no public repository; delivered through Stripe's general SDKs.
Amex Intent Intelligence: proprietary framework, part of the ACE Developer Kit: no specification or public repository found.
Official repositories added together in each panel
A2A: A2A, a2a-python, a2a-js, a2a-java, a2a-go, a2a-dotnet, a2a-rs, a2a-samples, a2a-inspector
MCP: modelcontextprotocol, typescript-sdk, python-sdk, java-sdk, go-sdk, csharp-sdk, rust-sdk
UCP: ucp, python-sdk, js-sdk, samples, conformance, ucp-schema
AGNTCY: oasf, dir, slim, identity, app-sdk, dir-sdk-javascript, slim-bindings
Third-party repositories added together (hand-picked examples; ‡ = counted under more than one protocol)
Web Bot Auth: vestauth, samesame, regent-httpsig
Up to three per protocol that implement the protocol itself (SDK, server, library, plugin), highest stars first,
after setting aside applications that merely use it and curated lists. This is a sample, not a census.
GitHub repositories tagged with each protocol topic, applications included: MCP 46,167, x402 4,648, A2A 645, L402 136, UCP 69, Web Bot Auth 50, ACP 28, AP2 20, ERC-8004 415, AGNTCY 10.
